summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to remove deed restrictions from a 3.62-acre parcel of land in Paducah, Kentucky, previously conveyed to the City of Paducah, with conditions that the land can only be transferred to the Oscar Cross Boys & Girls Club of Paducah and must continue to be used for public or recreational purposes.
